blinding_guess.why: The only use of the URDF model type binds rdf_loader.getURDF() to a const boost::shared_ptr<urdf::ModelInterface>& (and getSRDF() to boost::shared_ptr<srdf::Model>), and the code never names urdf::ModelInterfaceSharedPtr; for a lunar target, where the URDF/SRDF pointer typedefs are std::shared_ptr, that binding is likely not to compile.

notes: Both packet elements are consumed; this package provides none of them, so declares and not_declared are empty. api:urdf::ModelInterface is named once, in URKinematicsPlugin::initialize (ur_moveit_plugin.cpp:179), spelled as boost::shared_ptr<urdf::ModelInterface> and bound to the return of moveit rdf_loader::RDFLoader::getURDF(); the same object is then passed to robot_model::RobotModel(urdf_model, srdf) at line 187 and dereferenced into kdl_parser::treeFromUrdfModel at line 206. The header is pulled in via #include <urdf_model/model.h> (line 82). api:urdf::ModelInterfaceSharedPtr is not named anywhere in snapshot/ur_kinematics (grep for ModelInterface, SharedPtr, shared_ptr, urdf:: across src/ and include/); it gets no port and is in neither references nor any other list. The whole snapshot was also grepped: ur_moveit_plugin.cpp is the only file that names urdf::. package.xml does not list urdf, urdfdom or urdfdom_headers as a direct dependency (the type arrives through moveit_core / kdl_parser). The element is a C++ type, not a ROS interface, so msg_type, frame, units, QoS, rate and definition_id are null (ROS 1, no message definition). No exclusive resources are claimed: this is a MoveIt kinematics plugin with no hardware interfaces or device handles. The references list is limited to packet elements; the file also uses other external APIs (rdf_loader::RDFLoader, kdl_parser::treeFromUrdfModel, robot_model::RobotModel, srdf::Model) that are not packet elements.
